# The names that the standard library of Rust 1.90.0 (core, alloc, std) defines, for
# minifier level 3 (ADR 0045). Written by
# `cargo run -p cg-bundler --example std-names`; do not edit.
# Each line is the kinds of a name, then the name. Kinds: `m`, a pub fn, const,
# type or static, an item of a trait or trait impl, or a pub field, which `.name`
# or `T::name` reaches; `i`, a struct, enum, union, trait, mod or macro; `p`, in a
# prelude, reached by the bare name; `v`, an enum variant.
